title: Acta calendar definition, version 1
description: A calendar's definition as Acta's catalog takes it: a JSON object whose kind names its shape. An availability family takes weekly-availability, union, intersection, or subtraction; an occurrence family takes explicit-instants, daily-local-time, business-day, at-opening, or union. This schema checks a definition's shape. The rules that need more than shape are the compiler's, and the API answers them by path: a window ends after it starts, a range's end is not before its start, a date exists, a zone is one the host knows, and a definition holds at most 64 KB, 8 levels of JSON, and 5000 list items.

$schema.description: The schema this file is written against, for an editor. Taken at the root only, and not stored with the calendar.

occurrence.description: An occurrence source written inline: the instants a schedule fires at.

availability.description: An availability calendar written inline: the windows during which firing is allowed.

explicitInstants.description: A fixed list of instants; exhausted after the last.

instants.description: The instants to fire at, each a UTC instant or a local date-time read in the zone.

dailyLocalTime.description: The listed local times on the listed weekdays, minus the excluded dates.

times.description: The local times to fire at on each listed day.

days.description: The weekdays to fire on; every day when left out.

businessDay.description: The nth first or last business day of each week, month, quarter, or year, at a local time.

select.description: Which end of the period to count from.

period.description: The period to count in; a week starts on Monday.

nth.description: Which business day, counted from the end that select names; 1 when left out. A period with fewer has no occurrence.

businessDays.description: The weekdays that count as business days; Monday to Friday when left out.

holidays.description: The dates that count as no business days.

time.description: The local time to fire at.

atOpening.description: An occurrence at the start of each window of an availability calendar.

occurrenceUnion.description: Fires whenever one of its sources does.

weeklyAvailability.description: Local windows by weekday, replaced on listed dates, with ranges cut out after everything else.

weekly.description: The rules: the windows that are open on the listed weekdays.

dateOverrides.description: A date and the windows that replace its weekday's on that date; an empty list closes the date.

excludedRanges.description: Ranges cut out of the windows: whole local dates, or UTC instants.

intersection.description: Open only while every operand is.

subtraction.description: Open while from is open and minus is not.

note.description: A note for operators; it changes nothing the calendar computes.

timeZone.description: The zone local times are read in: an IANA or Windows zone id, or "schedule" for the zone of the schedule that uses the calendar, which is also what leaving it out means.

time.description: A local time, HH:mm or HH:mm:ss.

window.description: A local window as a pair, ["09:00", "17:00"]. It ends at "24:00" for the end of the day, and one whose end is not after its start ends on the next date.

weekday.description: A weekday by its English name, case ignored.

instant.description: A UTC instant with a Z or an offset, 2027-01-15T16:00:00Z, or a local date-time read in the zone, 2027-01-15T16:00.

utcInstant.description: A UTC instant with its Z, yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ.
